shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -50 && git ls-files | head -50

cat index.html src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__ node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.316/405423b37349a4f1dfdb7420659d736e/dataviz/references

cd /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.316/405423b37349a4f1dfdb7420659d736e/dataviz/references && cat palette.md marks-and-anatomy.md interaction.md | head -400; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/theme 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.js | head -80; cat build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -o "\-\-g-color-[a-z-]*" styles/styles.css | sort -u | grep -E "base-background|text-(primary|secondary|hint)|line-generic|base-float|private-" | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat ThemeProvider.d.ts types.d.ts; sed -n 1,80p ThemeProvider.js; grep -n "useThemeValue\|useThemeType\|ThemeProvider\|Text\b\|Card\b" ../../index.d.ts ../index.d.ts | head

cd /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.316/405423b37349a4f1dfdb7420659d736e/dataviz && node scripts/validate_palette.js "#2a78d6,#eb6834,#1baf7a" --mode light 2>&1 | tail -25; node scripts/validate_palette.js "#3987e5,#d95926,#199e70" --mode dark 2>&1 | tail -25

sed -i 's/Тысяч визитов в месяц, 2026/Визитов в месяц, 2026/' src/App.tsx && sed -i 's/<li key={s.name} style={{ color: undefined }}>/<li key={s.name}>/' src/LineChart.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) | head
cd /tmp/ssr && sed -i "s#from 'vite'#from '/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/vite/dist/node/index.js'#" check.mjs && node check.mjs /home/sandbox/workspace 2>&1 | tail -10

cd /tmp/ssr && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='check.mjs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("const React = (await s.ssrLoadModule('react')).default;\nconst { renderToString } = await s.ssrLoadModule('react-dom/server');",
"import { createRequire } from 'node:module';\nconst req = createRequire('/home/sandbox/workspace/package.json');\nconst React = req('react');\nconst { renderToString } = req('react-dom/server');")
# imports must be top-level; move
lines=s.split('\n')
imp=[l for l in lines if l.startswith('import ')]
rest=[l for l in lines if not l.startswith('import ')]
open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(imp+rest))
EOF
node check.mjs /home/sandbox/workspace 2>&1 | tail -10
cd /tmp/ssr && sed -i "s#logLevel: 'error' }#logLevel: 'error', ssr: { noExternal: ['@gravity-ui/uikit'] } }#" check.mjs && node check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -10
